text:
maya: Quick heads-up — small clarification needed on the benchmark blog before we push. Saw a Hacker News thread flagging that our latency numbers mix 95th and p99 in one chart. We should add a short explainer + exact hardware footnote. Embargo is still noon PST tomorrow, but we need this done today.
ryan: I can add a footnote and regenerate the chart SVG. the 95th was measured with batching=8, p99 with batching=1 — should call that out. ETA ~2h.
olga: Let's hold outreach until the updated post is live. I'll tell press contacts there's a minor clarification coming, no full re-brief needed. @maya can you confirm the copy? :ear: 
jin: Do we need to update the readme/benchmark repo too, or just the blog post? We should avoid future confusion.
maya: Good q — both. @ryan please push the chart + footnote to the repo and ping me when done. olga, hold any press pings until I say go. jin, can you open a tiny PR to the repo docs after ryan's changes?
ryan: putting suggested footnote below — please review: 
```
Note: Latency percentiles reported in the charts mix independently measured 95th and p99 values due to differing sampling windows. 95th values used batching=8; p99 values used batching=1 to capture tail behavior. All runs used instance: A100-40GB, sequence=2048, model=redwood/benchmark-v1.
```
olga: LGTM. I'll prepare a short email for top-tier outlets: "minor clarification added to methodology; no change to headline results."
maya: Perfect. Timeline: ryan done by +2h (1852105367), maya review +15m after that, push live +30m, olga pings press immediately after live. I'll update the embargo sheet.
deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled publish job (marketing/publish) set for 2025-07-22T19:00:00Z will be paused until manual resume.
ryan: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/benchmarks/pull/412 — added footnote and regenerated svg.
maya: Reviewing now. If no blockers I'll greenlight at 1852104667. Thanks everyone. :+1:
olga: saving the press list note in /marketing/embargoes, will stand by for the go.
jin: doc PR queued to add a short FAQ entry explaining percentile/batching choices.
maya: Closing loop: once live, we'll add a short pinned thread in #general linking to the update and the methodology FAQ.
